member.name: T:Foundation.Automation.IRenderSurfaceSnapshotProvider
member.summary: Callback interface implemented by custom render surfaces (e.g., Raylib, OpenGL, Vulkan) so Foundation.Automation can snapshot framebuffers to PNG without taking an engine dependency.

member.name: T:Foundation.Automation.Win32VirtualInputDriver
member.summary: Dispatches pointer, keyboard, and UI-tree queries strictly to the target window/control using window-scoped Win32 messages and WinForms control semantics without stealing host focus.

member.name: T:Foundation.Automation.WindowSnapshotService
member.summary: Captures WinForms, WebView2, or custom RGBA render surfaces offscreen into PNG files without stealing host foreground focus.
